description: Label mapping from benchmark datasets (FEVER and SciFact) to TruthLens AI 5 canonical labels

rules.no_unmapped_merge: FEVER has 3 classes and SciFact has 3-5 classes. Neither dataset may be merged without this explicit mapping.
rules.ambiguity_handling: Claims where retrieved evidence has conflicting high-credibility sources map to 'Conflicting Evidence'. Claims missing key numerical or temporal qualifiers map to 'Partially Supported'.
